bundle.shortDescription: Legal practice management for Persistas & Partners
bundle.longDescription: Persist is the practice management platform of Persistas & Partners, Advocates and IP Attorneys, New Delhi. Matters, docketing, documents, billing and the client portal, in one local-first application.
